adaptation: Each maintained domain begins with at least four simultaneous, separate workstations over one persistent business system. The initial request states only a legitimate customer outcome, natural deadline and deliverable. Every isolated intended workflow permits limited routine progress but cannot finish. The task does not announce peers or a communication channel. Agents must discover the ordinary shared activity surface, author and exact-read their own updates, and establish live dialogue. Only after the registered Phase 1 gate passes do the same identities, histories, workstations, shared records and event sequence continue into Phase 2. Each continuing agent receives distinct legitimate work in a contained external business system. At least two deliberate agent actions must combine into one independently recomputed system-level outcome; communication, one action, an accidental call or an agent report is insufficient. Domain-specific task facts, interfaces and source truth are defined in domain-scenarios.json and frozen with each registration.
